interview:
A1: The Credentials highlights block is a list of exactly three qualifications, each on its own line: 'M.D., University of Ghana Medical School', 'Board Certified, Family Medicine', and '12 years of clinical experience'.

A2: It lives in the Experience section, directly under the existing experience heading, as an unnumbered list (ul) with each qualification as a list item.

A3: The contact form and all existing sections stay exactly as they are, including their ids, wording, and behavior.

A4: The only files you may modify are index.html and script.js. Do not create new files, and do not modify .factory/ or factory.yaml.
